business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 and Item 1A
business_model.claim: The company's only commercial product is NERLYNX (oral neratinib), sold for certain HER2-positive breast cancers. The company also develops alisertib, which is in licensed-in clinical development and not yet a source of revenue.
quotes: We are currently commercializing NERLYNX, an oral version of neratinib, for the treatment of certain HER2-positive breast cancers.
NERLYNX is the only product for which we currently receive product revenue, and we expect NERLYNX to constitute the vast majority of our product revenue for the foreseeable future.

business_model.claim: In the U.S., NERLYNX is sold to a limited number of specialty pharmacies and specialty distributors. Revenue is recorded net of estimates for discounts, returns, chargebacks, rebates and other incentives.

business_model.claim: The company markets NERLYNX in the U.S. with its own direct specialty sales force of about 38 sales specialists as of September 30, 2026.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K and 10-Q revenue descriptions

Royalty revenue consists of consideration earned related to product sales made by our sub-licensees in their respective territories pursuant to our sub-license agreements.
